_icons._typeIcon: All Escape cards carry a running-figure type icon in the top-right corner, next to an association icon: Lockbox = Power The Gate, Truck = Fix The Truck, Angle Grinder = Service Tunnels, Flare Gun = Fire The Flare, hatted face = The Butcher, hooded figure = The Cult, tentacle coil = The Horror

cards.name: North Gate
cards.setup:
Place the {saw} (Saw) token on space S-17 and the {escape-locked} (Locked Escape) token on space 10 on the main board
Roll a D6 to determine where the {lockbox} (Lockbox) token is placed:
1-2: S-1
3-4: 104
5-6: S-41
cards.notes: Setup-only card; no additional rules text

cards.name: The Grave
cards.setup:
Have the Adversary place the {grave-faceup} (face-up Grave) token on any space on their mini-map within 10 spaces of any Investigator
Then, have the Adversary place the {grave-facedown} (face-down Grave) token on any space on the main board within 3 spaces of the actual {grave-faceup} token
cards.text: See the Banish The Butcher player aid for more details
cards.notes: The face-up Grave is placed hidden on the Adversary's mini-map; the face-down Grave on the main board acts as a decoy marker within 3 spaces of the real one

cards.name: The Altar
cards.setup: Have the Adversary place the {ritual-knife} (Ritual Knife) and {rope-circle} (Rope Circle) tokens on any space on the main board within 10 spaces of the {altar} (Altar) token
cards.text: See the Banish The Cult player aid for more details

cards.name: The Eggs
cards.setup: Have the Adversary take 4 {egg-sac} (Egg Sac) tokens. The Adversary must place 1 {egg-sac} token within 3 spaces of themself on any space on the main board at any time during each of their next 4 turns
cards.text: See the Banish The Horror player aid for more details
